assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Premium mature Cyberpunk RED 2045 RPG catalogue illustration, detailed hand-drawn CEL SHADING. Fine varied ink contour and crisp large shadow planes, realistic adult proportions and engineered construction, secondary reflected-light shapes, clear differentiation of cloth, metal, polymer and glass. Restrained local wear, materially convincing details concentrated around the subject, softer lower-contrast atmospheric background. Lived-in retrofuturist city after economic collapse, repaired practical technology. Cinematic light, readable main subject and generous safe margins. Never cute or toy-like, no thick uniform icon outline, no photoreal photograph or glossy 3D render, no uniform grain, no unreadable pseudo-text, no letters, logos, watermark, borders or UI. Wide 5:2 scene of a powerful autonomous security daemon: a tangible dark server control core in a secure utility room, a small angular amber artificial face made of lit segmented planes on its front, three substantial cables running from the core to visible camera and turret control hardware behind it. The daemon is software managing a security network, not an occult monster. Tense amber/cool cyan light. No supernatural fire, pentagrams or fantasy creatures.
